# Physical Post-Mute replay fixtures

These immutable screenshots come from the completed Mythyl run
`9597985e-d357-4a44-a3d5-a6f0457ca05e` (request
`46a45bf5-3c90-4ee1-863a-6980d07aec74`) on runtime
`ff99db6d7de48d75ede439c704e770feaaec6b7c`.

The set covers four public profiles that reached a visually confirmed
`No Posts Yet` surface after the existing reveal, one public profile with
posts, and the two physical fallback sequences for `mbambu.gedeon` and
`ravinderbathua_`.

The production run did not persist matching hierarchy XML for these captures.
Tests therefore distinguish physical image replay from synthetic hybrid-state
coverage. A visual blank-grid result is never sufficient by itself: the
production decision still requires fresh XML empty evidence, zero fresh
tappable post tiles, exact identity/package/navigation proof, a stable
fingerprint, and an unexpired context.
